info.longName: Eaton Vance Short Duration Income ETF

funds_data.description: Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by primarily investing in a diversified portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated fixed income securities of varying maturities consistent with ordinarily seeking to maintain an average duration of approximately three years or less. The fund invests primarily in U.S. government securities, corporate bonds and mortgage- and asset-backed securities.
